Name: Ethni, Son of Zerah
Summary: Son of Zerah and father of Malchiah in Asaph's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:41: Son of Zerah and father of Malchiah in Asaph's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ethni stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
